phase: Phase 4: The runner and the first track A results (by Sun 2026-11-22)
summary: Pass with one nonblocking defect. I attacked the new code paths of ee48a25..c0a26d7 with a new suite, harness/model-guide-tests/adversarial-p4c.test.ts, committed as bd967a7. Thirteen cases cover the key scan of error lines, the region detection, the judge verdict scan behind the event-stream decoder, the token log at its limits, and the queue decoder with hostile stored outputs. One case failed at the audited HEAD and pins a real defect: a hostile call that splits a credential value across two stdout error events sends the tail of the value into the runner stdout and the run record, because the error line is the message of the last error event only and the byte scan holds no full value. The full value never prints and the record stays in the private folder, so the PM rule of 2026-11-19 keeps the finding nonblocking (backlog 4.14); the pin stays it.skip in the committed file. The other twelve cases pass as guard pins: the whole-file scan masks a key of an earlier error event, the stderr region phrase wins while a stdout error event holds no region text, the nested error.data.message region event gives region-blocked, a forged verdict block loses to the last flat block, a hostile stream of invalid JSON and one huge text event still yields the verdict, the safe-integer limit and zero count exactly, an infinite value counts as zero, and the queue decoder survives a mixed hostile stream, a four-megabyte line, an empty text event, and a text event that wins over plain text. The review-run and judge-run suites still pass, so the range broke no regression.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-P4C-1 [Nit] (backlog 4.14) A hostile call that splits a credential value across two stdout error events leaks the tail of the value into the runner stdout and the judge run record. error_event_text (judge-run.sh:592-616, review-run.sh:813-837) takes the message of the LAST error event only, and the byte scan of scan_output holds no full literal when the value is split, so the decoded-line grep misses too and error_line_of prints the raw tail. Pinned failing at the audited HEAD: 'ADV-P4C E the key scan of error lines and the region detection > E1 a value split across two stdout error events never reaches the record (ADV-P4C-1)' observed 'judge-run: the model call failed on group d-01#G1: dential-value-0123456789 before the retry; the run stops' on stdout and in the record errors. The full value never prints and the record sits in the private folder, so no committed file or public page can hold a real key: nonblocking per the PM rule of 2026-11-19. The pin stays it.skip in the committed file. Fix direction: when the output holds more than one error event, fail closed to the fixed text, or scan every error-event message against the value list.
